text.content:
The city's staircase: pleasure at the bottom, the gated hills at the top.

Region: Night City, north-east. Districts: Japantown (G), Charter Hill (H), North Oak (I)
Controlled by: The Tyger Claws in Japantown; the campus corps' consortium on Charter Hill; Lazarus and estate security in North Oak
The feel of it: Entertainment, ambition and estates, with the best Net in the city and the worst privacy
Notable locations: Jig-Jig Street, Clouds, Cherry Blossom Market, the Moon Garden, the old Ziggurat tower; the Kiroshi, Dynalar and Rocklin campuses; the Arasaka Estate, the Columbarium, Chram Denya Jinja
Danger: Moderate / Corporate in Japantown; Corporate on Charter Hill; Executive in North Oak

At the bottom is Japantown, where corpos come down to play and the Claws take a cut of every eddie. Halfway up is Charter Hill, the campus towers where the ambitious go to prove they've climbed out of the gutter. At the top is North Oak, where the people who own the staircase live behind walls you can't see over.

According to Lattice, every camera in Japantown is selling to someone, usually two someones.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.22; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.09
